description: Codex-first workflow skills for gated, auditable AI-assisted software delivery.
claudeDescription: Codex-first workflow skills and control templates for gated, auditable AI-assisted software delivery.
shortDescription: Codex-first workflow skills for gated, auditable AI-assisted delivery.
longDescription: AI Governance & Delivery Framework (AGDF) packages reusable Codex-first skills, control templates and machine-readable repository checks for gate decisions, Brownfield analysis, task-plan review, solution-integrity review, QA decisions, durable run state and auditable delivery closeout.

defaultPrompt: Run an AGDF gate check for this request.
Create an AGDF control scaffold for this repository.
Use AGDF Brownfield analysis before implementation.
Close this run with an AGDF orchestration report.

skillSet.useFor: high-impact planning decisions with several plausible next delivery steps before implementation
skillSet.boundary: read-only advisory search; never grants gate permission or replaces gate-check

skillSet.useFor: after gate-check permits Brownfield Review or implementation preparation, before non-trivial changes in existing systems
skillSet.boundary: clarifies reuse, owners, risks and Mode/Slice Decision; never bypasses gate-check; Brownfield Review is not implementation permission

skillSet.useFor: inspect workarounds, fallbacks, parallel structures or symptom fixes
skillSet.boundary: not a TP or QA substitute

skillSet.useFor: mandatory CR step after code changes, focused on defects, regression and security findings
skillSet.boundary: does not replace TP review, clean review or QA

skillSet.useFor: new build/change intent, unclear approval, Structured Delivery, later-gate artefact requested
skillSet.boundary: does not create later artefacts or skip Mode/Slice Decision after Brownfield Review

skillSet.useFor: auditable closeout for every relevant run
after implementation and before QA, verify TP coverage
